result:
The old clock ticked, each second a hesitant drop across the precipice of time. It was a familiar rhythm, hypnotizing in its predictability, a constant against the whirlwind of thoughts that danced within me. There were days when I felt as if I were caught in a perpetual loop, stuck in a cycle of waking with the same unease, of facing the screen filled with news that seemed to amplify the abyss within.

But there were others, those rare bursts of clarity, moments of blossom in chaos, where the world outside ceased to be a source of turmoil. Then, I would revel in the sunshine, focusing only on the texture of sand against my fingertips, stirring in the salt-laced wind, the smell of earth after rain, a symphony of sensory delight that felt real, immediate. 

The clock ticked, a reminder of the endless process of time's unyielding march. But within it, I found a quiet sanctuary – a reminder that even amidst such chaos, the simple steps of living could connect me to something profoundly beautiful. And in those moments, the cycle wasn't a burden, it was a transformation. A constant, if unhurried, dance.
